subject: Hosting commitment letters + connectivity checklist for Orchard pilot
messages:
From: Samira Khan <security@orchard-health.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, CloudPartner <partner@cloudpartner.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T13:14:00Z
Subject: Request: hosting assurance letters + connectivity checklist for pilot

Hi Jordan / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orchard is excited to start the pilot. Before we begin provisioning we need two items to satisfy our internal security reviewers:

1) A short hosting commitment letter that confirms production inference for our pilot will be served only from US-based regions (no cross-border replication) and that KMS keys used for Orchard tenant data will be logically partitioned. This will go into our vendor packet.

2) A private connectivity checklist / runbook we can hand to our networking team outlining VPC peering/private-link steps, ip ranges, expected test flow and rollback steps.

Can you provide a draft of both (word/pdf) and, if possible, a DocuSign-ready hosting letter? If CloudPartner needs to be looped for peering, please cc them. Target timeframe: internal sign-off by 2026-07-15 and a test connection the week of 2026-07-19.

Thanks — if you need any specifics about our environment I can share them.

Samira Khan
Head of Security Operations
Orchard Health
security@orchard-health.com

---
Attachments requested: (none attached)

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <security@orchard-health.com>, CloudPartner <partner@cloudpartner.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T14:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: hosting assurance letters + connectivity checklist for pilot

Karthik / Laura — forwarding Samira's ask from Orchard. High level asks: US-only hosting confirmation + KMS partitioning language; VPC/private-link connection checklist + test plan. Samira would also like a DocuSign-ready letter.

Karthik: can you draft a short 1-page hosting commitment letter that covers region commitment (US), KMS partitioning language, and fallback model routing (i.e., if dedicated capacity isn't available we'll fail to a compatible variant but only within US regions)? Keep it non-legal but explicit for security review.

Laura: can you validate the networking checklist — fill in ip ranges, NAT/peering expectations, port lists, and a brief rollback play (what to do if we see auth errors / route blackholing). Attach our redwood_vpc_template_v2.pdf as a base.

I put CloudPartner on cc in case they want to handle the peering side.

Deadline: draft by 2026-07-02 so we can iterate with Orchard.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0129

Attachments: redwood_vpc_template_v2.pdf (see template for IP/route examples)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <security@orchard-health.com>, CloudPartner <partner@cloudpartner.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:37:00Z
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: hosting assurance letters + connectivity checklist for pilot

Jordan / Laura / Samira — attaching the first drafts per the ask. See the Drive link below for editable copies.

Included: 
- Draft_Hosting_Commitment_Letter_ORCHARD_v1.docx (summary commitments: US-only region hosting, KMS envelope + tenant key partitioning, data-at-rest & in-transit encryption, logs retention window, fallback within US-only model variants)
- Private-Link-Connection-Checklist.xlsx (steps, expected IP blocks, pre-reqs for Orchard network, test orchestration timeline)
- redwood_vpc_template_v2.pdf (our network diagram / sample routes)

A few notes in the letter to call out for legal/security review:
- We used the phrase "logical KMS partitioning per-customer" rather than committing to customer-owned keys; if Orchard needs a customer-managed key (BYOK) we can escalate to the Private deployment track.
- The checklist assumes PrivateLink peering across AWS in us-east-1; if you require a different region we can swap the CIDR and endpoint details.

Drive (editable): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E6f

Samira — can you review and flag any language that must change for your procurement team? If this looks good I'll convert the letter to a DocuSign-ready PDF and send back.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: Draft_Hosting_Commitment_Letter_ORCHARD_v1.docx; Private-Link-Connection-Checklist.xlsx; redwood_vpc_template_v2.pdf

From: Samira Khan <security@orchard-health.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthisk@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, CloudPartner <partner@cloudpartner.com>, DocuSign <docusign@docusign.net>
Date: 2026-07-07T10:22:00Z
Subject: RE: Draft hosting letter + checklist received — small edits

Karthik / Jordan — thanks, received the drafts and the Drive link. Quick requested edits from my side after an initial review with our security and procurement teams: 

1) KMS wording: please add an explicit sentence that "tenant encryption keys are logically separated and access-controlled such that Orchard tenant keys are not accessible by other tenants or third-party services without explicit authorization." That should satisfy our auditors.

2) Retention & logs: can you add the maximum log retention period (we prefer 90 days for request logs) and a contact method for SOC2 evidence requests (security@redwood.com as a ticketing contact + SOC2 report access process).

3) Checklist: please include a short step labeled "connection smoke test" with expected success criteria (TLS handshake, OIDC token validation, 5-minute inference latency below 600ms for 1k token sample) and a rollback step to remove the BGP advertisement if routing issues are detected.

If you can push a revised hosting letter to DocuSign by EOD 2026-07-09 we can get internal signatures and aim for a test connection the week of 2026-07-19 as planned.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Security Operations | Orchard Health
security@orchard-health.com
